title: Maytag Commercial — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Maytag Commercial.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Built for Business." Value tier. Maytag Commercial is the commercial laundry brand from Whirlpool Corporation — built for laundromats, multi-housing, and on-premise laundry. Commercial-grade construction with coin-operated and card-reader payment options.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Laundromats, apartments, hotels, commercial laundry facilities.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Maytag Commercial:

• Commercial-grade for laundromat and multi-housing

• Coin and card payment systems available

• Whirlpool Corporation engineering and support

• Built to handle 10,000+ cycles per year

• Industry-leading reliability in commercial laundry
